RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the July 15, 2004/Asadha 24, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Prime  Minister;  Agro  and  Rural  Industries;  Atomic  Energy;
Communications and Information Technology;  External Affairs;  Labour and
Employment; Non-Resident Indians Affairs; Ocean Development; Personnel,
Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Road Transport and Highways;
Science and Technology; Shipping; Small Scale Industries; Space;
Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions—20

Survey on housing situation
†*141. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of STATISTICS AND
PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have carried
out any survey on the housing situation in
the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) whether Government propose to
formulate any special action plan to
provide homes to the homeless on the basis
of the said survey; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken by
Government in this direction?
Progress of construction work of
NH-57
†*142. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY: Will the Minister of  ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the progress of construction work
of National Highway No. 57 in Bihar;
(b) the amount spent on the widening
and strengthening of the said highway during
the last three years;
(c) whether the said project would be
completed within the stipulated period;
and
(d) if so, Government’s plan in this
regard, year-wise?
Telephone exchanges in
Nagaland
*143. SHRI T.R. ZELIANG: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the present capacity of the telephone
exchanges in the State of Nagaland,
exchange-wise;
(b) the number of phones presently
lying out of order in the cities of the
State during the last one year, till date;
and
(c) the steps being taken or proposed
to be taken by Government in this
regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

44

Small scale industries in the country
*144. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL : Will
the Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of small scale industries
registered and functioning at present in the
different parts of the country, State-wise;
(b) the details of the foreign exchange
earned by these industries during the last
three years, year-wise; and
(c) the details of such industries that
closed down due to sickness, so far during
the year 2003-04, State-wise?
Statutory dues of C.P.S.U. employees
*145. SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to refer to the answer to Unstarred
Question 1798 given in the Rajya Sabha on
the 18th December, 2003 and state:
(a) the status of payment of outstanding
dues to employees of the Central Public
Sector Undertakings which were Rs. 1915
crores as on the 31st March, 2003;
(b) whether a monitoring body has been
set up to liquidate the dues in a time bound
schedule; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Women’s wage rates
*146. SHRIMATI SARLA MAHESH-
WARI: Will the Minister of LABOUR
AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
according to the UNDP Human
Development Report women’s wage rates
are on an average 75 per cent of men’s wage
rates and constitute only one fourth of the
family income;
(b) if so, whether Government are
considering to enact labour laws for these
women workers; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Task Force on problems of WLL vs.
GSM
*147. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
constituted a Task Force of technical experts
from IITs, CSIR, TCIL and others to ensure
that WLL limited mobile services do not
suffer due to unnecessary representation
by Cellular Operators Association of India;
and
(b) if so, the details of the outcome of
the Task Force constituted to look into the
problems of WLL vs. GSM?
Indo-Pak Border
*148. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have not ruled
out the possibility of altering India's
borders with Pakistan to resolve the
Kashmir dispute;
(b) if so, whether there is any departure
from the past policy; and
(c) if not, Government's views to get a
solution on the Kashmir dispute?
India’s relations with Pakistan and
Bangladesh
*149. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the extent of progress made in
developing relations with Pakistan and
Bangladesh in the socio-economic and
political fields;

(b) whether the issue of trade and
commerce from the North-eastern region
with Bangladesh and with other regions of
our country across Bangladesh has been
taken up, so far; and
(c) the achievements in this respect so
far?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the July 15, 2004/Asadha 24, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; External Affairs; Labour
and Employment; Non-Resident Indians Affairs; Ocean Development;
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Road Transport
and Highways; Science and Technology; Shipping; Small Scale
Industries; Space; Statistics and Programme Implementation )
Total number of questions—93
Export of coir products
400.  SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of  AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government are aware of
the increasing demand for natural fibres in
global market;
(b)  if so, the action taken for increasing
the export of coir and coir products; and
(c)  the details of the coir and coir
products exported and the amount of
foreign exchange earned during the last three
years, year-wise/State-wise and category-
wise?
Conference regarding ARIs and SSIs
†401.  SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of  AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether suggestions have been made
to improve the monetary limit along with
complete definitions of Rural Industries,
Small Industries and Tiny Industries in the
Conference of Rural Industries Ministers
and Ministers of States for Small Scale
Industries;
(b) if so, the recommendations made in
this Conference;
(c)  whether there is any proposal to
amend the present law to implement these
recommendations; and
(d)  if so, the details of the steps to be
taken by Government to implement the
recommendations made in the Conference?
Illegal telephone exchanges
402.  SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of  COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the estimated number of illegal
telephone exchanges operating in Delhi and
its roundabout;
(b) whether these telephone exchanges
provide international telephony by-passing
the licensed service providers;
(c) if so, the estimated loss of revenue
being suffered by Government per month
due to this reason;

exchanges busted, so far, during the last
three years; and
(e) the number of persons running these
illegal telephone exchanges, who have been
arrested and prosecuted so far?
Communication  facilities in rural
areas
403.  SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of Government's schemes
for providing  communication facilities in
rural areas of the country;
(b) the  number of villages in North-
Eastern Region where wireless and local
loop services have been provided and the
number of villages in which the above said
facilities have not been provided; and
(c) the reasons therefor?
Modernisation of telegraph services
in NER
404.  SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
initiative for modernisation of telegraph
services in Assam and other NER States;
(b) if so, the details thereof, district-
wise;
(c) whether any budgetary allocations
have been made for this purpose during the
current year; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Complaints against the functioning of
BSNL in NER
405.  SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of complaints received
by Government against the functioning of
BSNL in NER during the last three years;
and
(b) the action being taken or proposed
to be taken by Government in this regard?
Upgradation of telephone exchanges
in Uttaranchal
†406.  SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of  COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the telephone
exchanges which are to be upgraded in the
State  of  Uttaranchal  during  the  year
2004-05, district-wise;
(b) the availability of telephones
expected in the State by the year 2005; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
bring the availability of telephones in this
State upto the National level?
BSNL mobile phone connections in
Karnataka

Will the Minister of  COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of BSNL mobile
connections that have, so far, been provided
in the State of  Karnataka;
